column1: #corepath: Is the gene in the core cancer pathway
#pval_kruskal_multiGroup: P-value of the Kruskal-Wallis test test for all pharmacological subtype
#pval_ttest_2Group: P-value of the student T test for the pharmacological subtype sensitive and resistant groups
#nodes.category_median_low2high.: Nodes of the drug pharmacology classification tree (sorted by median of category in ascending order)
#expr.category_median_low2high.: Expression median of the drug pharmacology classification tree (sorted by median of category in ascending order)
#resistant_num: Number of drug-resistant nodes(number of drug-resistant pharmacological subtypes)
#pval_U_eachTwoGroup: The p-value of the Mann-Whitney U test for each of the two pharmacological subtypes
#correlation_trend: Increasing median of expression is negative, decreasing is positive
#direction: Direction of drug and gene connection
#dir_corr: Pearson Correlation of mutation ratios and incremental sequences
#dir_p: Pearson correlation p-values of mutation proportions and incremental sequences
#sensi_p: Pearson correlation p-values for the median of expression in the sensitive group to the incremental sequence
#sensi_corr: Pearson correlation between the  median of expression in sensitive groups and incremental sequences
#sensi_trend:  The  median of expression in the sensitive group increased as negative and decreased as positive
#sensi_drugCorr: Pearson correlation of sample expression with drug IC50 in the sensitive group
#sensi_drugCorrP: Pearson correlation p-value of sample expression with drug IC50 in the sensitive group
#padj_ttest_2Group: Adjusted p-value of the chi-square test for the pharmacological subtype sensitive and resistant groups
#padj_kruskal_multiGroup: Adjusted p-value of the chi-square test for all pharmacological subtype
#padj_sensi_drugCorr: Adjusted p-values for Pearson correlation of sample expression with drug IC50 in the sensitive group.
